title: How to Learn a Language #9: What to Do When You’re in the Country
description: Let’s talk about how best to take advantage of the opportunity and time you have being in a Spanish-speaking country.
subtitles:
WEBVTT
Kind: captions
Language: en

00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:01.580
Hi!

00:00:01.580 --> 00:00:06.460
Everyone knows that the best way to learn a language,

00:00:06.460 --> 00:00:09.020
to reach a good level in a language,

00:00:09.020 --> 00:00:12.120
is to do immersion in the country, right?

00:00:12.120 --> 00:00:16.580
Go live in the country to be immersed in the language.

00:00:16.580 --> 00:00:21.060
But many times that doesn't work. Many times

00:00:21.060 --> 00:00:24.580
people live in the country where the language is spoken

00:00:24.580 --> 00:00:26.000
and don't learn the language,

00:00:26.000 --> 00:00:29.380
or don't make good use of their time and learn very little, right?

00:00:29.380 --> 00:00:32.560
So, in this video I'm going to explain

00:00:32.560 --> 00:00:35.840
what are the biggest problems people encounter

00:00:35.840 --> 00:00:39.240
when they go to live in another country, and how to solve them.

00:00:39.240 --> 00:00:42.620
How to make sure we make good use of our time

00:00:42.620 --> 00:00:48.060
and make the most of our stay in the country to learn the language fast.

00:00:48.060 --> 00:00:53.420
So, living in the country is great. When learning a language, it's really good.

00:00:53.420 --> 00:00:58.860
Because you have exposure to the language automatically.

00:00:58.860 --> 00:01:02.180
You are walking down the street and read signs.

00:01:02.180 --> 00:01:07.320
In the subway, the lady who announces the stops goes: "next stop, Prado".

00:01:07.320 --> 00:01:10.600
She is speaking Spanish to you, right? You hear Spanish everywhere.

00:01:10.600 --> 00:01:15.840
When you go to the store, you have to speak Spanish with the clerk, right?

00:01:15.840 --> 00:01:19.140
But unfortunately, despite that, there are people

00:01:19.140 --> 00:01:23.120
who manage to live in the country for ten years

00:01:23.120 --> 00:01:25.900
and not learn the language that's spoken in the country.

00:01:25.900 --> 00:01:30.480
So, how to avoid that? How to prevent that from happening to us?

00:01:30.480 --> 00:01:34.240
The first thing is to arrive in the country

00:01:34.240 --> 00:01:38.040
already with a good level in the language.

00:01:38.040 --> 00:01:41.340
This is not 100% necessary.

00:01:41.340 --> 00:01:47.100
There are people who go to the country, know zero about the language, and manage to learn it.

00:01:47.100 --> 00:01:51.060
But it is much easier if when you arrive in the country

00:01:51.080 --> 00:01:54.280
you can already speak enough of it, you have at least

00:01:54.280 --> 00:01:57.780
an intermediate level. Even if it is a low intermediate level,

00:01:57.780 --> 00:02:00.520
but it helps, it helps a lot.

00:02:00.520 --> 00:02:05.580
Because, what happens if you go to the country and your level in the language is low

00:02:05.580 --> 00:02:07.940
or you can't say anything in the language?

00:02:07.940 --> 00:02:09.480
Well,

00:02:09.480 --> 00:02:11.400
when you arrive in the country

00:02:11.400 --> 00:02:14.700
the easiest way to solve your problems,

00:02:14.700 --> 00:02:16.980
your need for an apartment,

00:02:16.980 --> 00:02:22.580
your need to buy food in the supermarket, to go to restaurants,

00:02:22.580 --> 00:02:27.060
to get on the bus or in a taxi or whatever,

00:02:27.060 --> 00:02:30.620
the easiest way to solve those problems

00:02:30.620 --> 00:02:34.640
is not to learn the language. Learning the language takes a long time.

00:02:34.640 --> 00:02:40.700
The easiest way to solve those problems, or the need for friendships, to make friends,

00:02:40.700 --> 00:02:44.340
the easiest way is not to learn the language. It's to

00:02:44.340 --> 00:02:47.160
look for alternatives. To find ways

00:02:47.160 --> 00:02:50.120
to avoid having to speak the language.

00:02:50.120 --> 00:02:53.900
And people who go to a country and don't speak the language

00:02:53.900 --> 00:02:56.380
are often forced to do that,

00:02:56.380 --> 00:02:59.100
because realistically you can't wait

00:02:59.100 --> 00:03:02.240
until you're able to speak the language well to get an apartment,

00:03:02.240 --> 00:03:06.580
or many times even to have friends. For many people,

00:03:06.580 --> 00:03:10.220
having to be months or a year without friends

00:03:10.220 --> 00:03:14.220
because they are learning the language, is not possible.

00:03:14.220 --> 00:03:18.580
It's not something that many people would be fine with, or happy with.

00:03:18.580 --> 00:03:22.440
A lot of people would get depressed being so long without friends.

00:03:22.440 --> 00:03:27.000
Therefore, many people just end up looking for alternatives,

00:03:27.000 --> 00:03:33.400
looking for a supermarket where they don't need to talk, where they can just take what they need.

00:03:33.400 --> 00:03:37.080
Looking for restaurants that have a menu in English,

00:03:37.080 --> 00:03:40.780
or that have a menu with photos that you can point to

00:03:40.780 --> 00:03:44.380
and that's it, they can get food, right?

00:03:44.380 --> 00:03:47.140
They end up looking for alternatives in this way.

00:03:47.140 --> 00:03:52.040
Finding a friend to help them go to the bank to open an account,

00:03:52.040 --> 00:03:57.920
help them buy a cellphone, or any other of their needs.

00:03:57.920 --> 00:04:01.900
And of course, once you do that, once you

00:04:01.900 --> 00:04:04.980
have your whole life set up, you already know how to do

00:04:04.980 --> 00:04:08.240
all the necessary things. You already have friends.

00:04:08.240 --> 00:04:13.900
You no longer need to learn the language. You are already at a point where your life

00:04:13.900 --> 00:04:17.960
is more or less solved. You are more or less happy.

00:04:17.960 --> 00:04:20.280
Yes, it would be good to learn the language

00:04:20.280 --> 00:04:23.620
because occasionally there are things that are not very convenient, right?

00:04:23.620 --> 00:04:27.160
Maybe you don't understand what's written somewhere, or you don't understand somebody.

00:04:27.160 --> 00:04:29.480
yes, there are times when it's not very convenient,

00:04:29.480 --> 00:04:33.360
but hey, it's not a big deal, you get by because you already have food,

00:04:33.360 --> 00:04:36.460
you have a place to stay, you have friends. No worries.

00:04:36.460 --> 00:04:39.500
So, many people reach this point

00:04:39.500 --> 00:04:42.980
and then they become complacent, right? And they rationalize.

00:04:42.980 --> 00:04:46.560
And say: "No, no, to live here you don't need to know the language.

00:04:46.560 --> 00:04:49.480
I know I'm fine, I don't have to learn the language."

00:04:49.480 --> 00:04:59.060
So, let's say that you arrive in the country and your level in the language is not yet

00:04:59.060 --> 00:05:02.860
at the intermediate level, it's still not good enough.

00:05:02.860 --> 00:05:07.600
I recommend you do Crosstalk. Try to do Crosstalk as much as you can.

00:05:07.600 --> 00:05:11.880
Look for people who want to learn a language you speak,

00:05:11.880 --> 00:05:16.220
and if you can do Crosstalk every day, do it every day.

00:05:16.220 --> 00:05:19.340
If you can do two hours every day, if you have the time,

00:05:19.340 --> 00:05:20.980
I recommend you do it.

00:05:20.980 --> 00:05:24.380
At least until you reach that intermediate level.

00:05:24.380 --> 00:05:27.800
And to find a person to do Crosstalk with

00:05:27.800 --> 00:05:33.700
you can go to language exchanges. You can look for events on Meetup.com.

00:05:33.700 --> 00:05:37.720
Meetup.com, right? It is a website. Meetup.com.

00:05:37.720 --> 00:05:40.980
And there you can find language exchange events.

00:05:40.980 --> 00:05:45.000
Events where people go to exchange languages.

00:05:45.000 --> 00:05:48.440
I don't recommend doing Crosstalk at the event,

00:05:48.440 --> 00:05:54.120
because many people who go to the event don't go there to get serious about learning a language.

00:05:54.120 --> 00:05:59.100
Many people are talking in English all the time and that's it, and only speak English.

00:05:59.100 --> 00:06:02.660
I recommend you go to that event to meet people.

00:06:02.660 --> 00:06:08.320
To meet people with whom you can do Crosstalk later on, right?

00:06:08.320 --> 00:06:11.680
Meet people who are interested in learning your language

00:06:11.680 --> 00:06:17.060
and then, once you have their contact, have their WhatsApp, their email or Facebook,

00:06:17.060 --> 00:06:23.660
then you can meet, both of you, in a cafe, and do Crosstalk.

00:06:23.660 --> 00:06:27.180
You can do that, meet people at Meetup events,

00:06:27.180 --> 00:06:30.440
or you can use applications on your phone.

00:06:30.440 --> 00:06:33.700
Applications like Tandem or HelloTalk,

00:06:33.700 --> 00:06:38.680
and this way you can easily meet people who want to learn your language.

00:06:38.680 --> 00:06:44.200
So, both for people who go to the country and have a very low level,

00:06:44.200 --> 00:06:48.920
or even if your level is already good, if you have an intermediate level

00:06:48.920 --> 00:06:52.460
and you can more or less get by in the country,

00:06:52.460 --> 00:06:57.260
I recommend that you put yourself in situations

00:06:57.260 --> 00:07:00.320
where it's not easy to avoid the language.

00:07:00.320 --> 00:07:03.640
Put yourself in situations where it's not easy

00:07:03.640 --> 00:07:07.160
to speak only English or speak only your language.

00:07:07.160 --> 00:07:10.620
An example is to not go to live in a big city.

00:07:10.620 --> 00:07:13.040
If you really want to learn the language

00:07:13.040 --> 00:07:17.980
it is much better to go to live in a small city or a town

00:07:17.980 --> 00:07:20.760
where there are very few foreign people,

00:07:20.760 --> 00:07:25.720
and where there will often be fewer people who speak English.

00:07:25.720 --> 00:07:28.500
If you can, if you have that option,

00:07:28.500 --> 00:07:33.440
living in such a place is the ideal way to improve in the language

00:07:33.440 --> 00:07:37.120
because you are really going to feel that you need the language a lot more.

00:07:37.120 --> 00:07:41.660
Also, if you are going to work in the country or you are going to study in the country,

00:07:41.660 --> 00:07:45.400
then look for a job, a company or a school,

00:07:45.400 --> 00:07:49.920
where there aren't many foreigners, where the level of English

00:07:49.920 --> 00:07:53.160
is probably lower.

00:07:53.160 --> 00:07:56.760
Look for those jobs and those courses.

00:07:56.760 --> 00:08:01.520
For example, if you can work as an au pair and take care of children,

00:08:01.520 --> 00:08:04.300
then you can talk with children all day.

00:08:04.300 --> 00:08:08.100
Spend the whole day listening to the children and learning the language, right?

00:08:08.100 --> 00:08:12.020
Also, as I have told you before in the other videos,

00:08:12.020 --> 00:08:15.140
try to go to social activities

00:08:15.140 --> 00:08:18.280
in which local people participate,

00:08:18.280 --> 00:08:22.400
or to sports clubs of, I don't know, football, or bicycle,

00:08:22.400 --> 00:08:26.100
dance classes, playing chess,

00:08:26.100 --> 00:08:31.140
Yoga classes, cooking classes to learn to cook local cuisine.

00:08:31.140 --> 00:08:33.760
All that. All those types of activities.

00:08:33.760 --> 00:08:38.240
Look for the activities to which local people go that are not

00:08:38.240 --> 00:08:42.160
specifically for foreigners, or where there aren't many foreigners.

00:08:42.160 --> 00:08:45.320
It's also ideal to share a house

00:08:45.320 --> 00:08:48.060
or share an apartment with local people.

00:08:48.060 --> 00:08:52.060
With roommates, right? You live in an apartment or in a house

00:08:52.060 --> 00:08:57.160
where you have your own room, and there are local people staying in the other rooms.

00:08:57.160 --> 00:09:01.160
I did that in Japan and I think that's what helped me the most

00:09:01.160 --> 00:09:05.040
to really get to have a good level in Japanese.

00:09:05.040 --> 00:09:10.040
Or also if you can do home-stay, if you can stay with a family,

00:09:10.040 --> 00:09:13.820
especially a family with many people, with children.

00:09:13.820 --> 00:09:18.280
If there are grown-up children who have a certain age, then even better.

00:09:18.280 --> 00:09:22.840
And well, if you can get a local girlfriend or boyfriend or a wife or a husband

00:09:22.840 --> 00:09:26.980
then, of course, it will also help a lot to learn the language.

00:09:26.980 --> 00:09:30.140
But in this case also your level in the language

00:09:30.140 --> 00:09:35.120
has to be high enough, because otherwise you are going to end up speaking only English

00:09:35.120 --> 00:09:38.800
with your partner. Also, if you are going to travel around the country,

00:09:38.800 --> 00:09:41.760
there are ways to move around, there are ways to travel,

00:09:41.760 --> 00:09:45.200
that will naturally let you meet more local people.

00:09:45.200 --> 00:09:48.020
For example, if you travel on cheap buses,

00:09:48.020 --> 00:09:50.360
there will probably be many more local people.

00:09:50.360 --> 00:09:55.620
If you travel by bicycle you will be able to meet many people everywhere you stop.

00:09:55.620 --> 00:10:00.180
If you hitchhike then naturally you will talk to many people

00:10:00.180 --> 00:10:03.940
in the cars that pick you up when you are hitchhiking.

00:10:03.940 --> 00:10:07.720
And well, you can also go to places where people usually

00:10:07.720 --> 00:10:13.960
meet, like bars and parties, and other types of social activities, right?

00:10:13.960 --> 00:10:17.660
Well, basically this is it. When you are in the country

00:10:17.660 --> 00:10:21.500
try not to get complacent.

00:10:21.500 --> 00:10:26.740
Don't end up getting into the easiest routine. Try to get out of your comfort zone,

00:10:26.740 --> 00:10:31.340
and do this kind of things, this kind of activities

00:10:31.340 --> 00:10:37.160
that allow you to meet the locals and be really more exposed to the language

00:10:37.160 --> 00:10:42.220
and to really get that immersion in the language, okay?

00:10:42.220 --> 00:10:48.200
In the following video I will explain what I think is the future of language learning,

00:10:48.200 --> 00:10:54.160
and what is the future of Dreaming Spanish, in which direction I want to take Dreaming Spanish.

00:00:30.720 --> 00:00:33.220
And this is very important for many people.

00:00:33.220 --> 00:00:35.620
So, many people ask me:

00:00:35.620 --> 00:00:38.420
"Ok, but what about practicing speaking?

00:00:38.420 --> 00:00:42.340
When do we start to practice speaking? How do we practice speaking?"

00:00:42.340 --> 00:00:46.740
So in this video I will explain what is the best moment.

00:00:46.740 --> 00:00:49.740
I will give you several options. I am going to explain to you

00:00:49.740 --> 00:00:56.300
the effect speaking has on language language learning, on language acquisition,

00:00:56.300 --> 00:01:02.000
So you can decide when you want to start talking.

00:01:02.000 --> 00:01:06.360
So, the first thing I want to clarify

00:01:06.360 --> 00:01:11.000
is that speaking does not result in acquisition.

00:01:11.000 --> 00:01:15.600
We don't acquire a language by speaking. At least not directly.

00:01:15.600 --> 00:01:21.260
As I explained, the way we acquire a language is with Comprehensible Input.

00:01:21.260 --> 00:01:25.880
With input: listening and reading things we understand.

00:01:25.880 --> 00:01:30.980
What's the issue? That speaking, well, we are not getting input, are we?

00:01:30.980 --> 00:01:33.220
Speaking, by definition, is output.

00:01:33.220 --> 00:01:35.860
When we talk we are using

00:01:35.860 --> 00:01:40.300
knowledge that we already have, information that we already have in our head,

00:01:40.300 --> 00:01:42.940
and we are talking using that information.

00:01:42.940 --> 00:01:47.760
Therefore we are not improving. We are not getting new information.

00:01:47.760 --> 00:01:53.560
We are not adding new information to that mental image, to that model

00:01:53.560 --> 00:01:56.980
of how grammar is used, how vocabulary is used.

00:01:56.980 --> 00:02:00.020
We are not really receiving any new information.

00:02:00.020 --> 00:02:04.140
That does not mean there are no advantages. There are many advantages!

00:02:04.140 --> 00:02:08.520
And the main advantage of talking, of talking to people,

00:02:08.520 --> 00:02:10.820
is that people talk back to us.

00:02:10.820 --> 00:02:14.240
Normally, unless someone is very unfriendly,

00:02:14.240 --> 00:02:18.260
when we say something to someone, that person talks back to us,

00:02:18.260 --> 00:02:20.580
and therefore gives us input.

00:02:20.580 --> 00:02:23.660
And not only do they give us input, but they give us input

00:02:23.660 --> 00:02:26.300
that's very relevant to our life.

00:02:26.300 --> 00:02:29.580
Because we are talking to that person in a store,

00:02:29.580 --> 00:02:33.480
or because we are talking to a boy or a girl that we like,

00:02:33.480 --> 00:02:38.100
or because we are talking with a friend. With a friend that we like, that we find nice.

00:02:38.100 --> 00:02:43.400
So, what that person is saying to us is very relevant to our life.

00:02:43.400 --> 00:02:49.520
We are paying attention because the other person expects us to pay attention.

00:02:49.520 --> 00:02:53.340
That's why it's much easier to pay attention to someone

00:02:53.340 --> 00:02:59.320
who speaks directly to us than to pay attention to an ugly dude on YouTube like me,

00:02:59.320 --> 00:03:02.260
or to a movie or series.

00:03:02.260 --> 00:03:06.440
What's the issue then? That talking also has drawbacks.

00:03:06.440 --> 00:03:09.880
It also has disadvantages. It has some problems.

00:03:09.880 --> 00:03:14.410
So now I will explain what these problems are.

00:03:14.410 --> 00:03:18.560
But as you can see, it has both advantages and disadvantages.

00:03:18.560 --> 00:03:21.780
And I'm going to tell you what the disadvantages are,

00:03:21.780 --> 00:03:24.020
so you can decide

00:03:24.020 --> 00:03:27.220
when do you want to start speaking,

00:03:27.220 --> 00:03:29.540
when do you want to start practicing speaking.

00:03:29.540 --> 00:03:34.860
And the biggest drawback of speaking, or of trying to practice speaking,

00:03:34.860 --> 00:03:37.820
or, I would say, to force oneself to speak

00:03:37.820 --> 00:03:41.440
when we still don't know the language well,

00:03:41.440 --> 00:03:45.600
is that we will end up creating in our head

00:03:45.600 --> 00:03:48.100
our own version of the language

00:03:48.100 --> 00:03:52.060
that is not the real language that native speakers use.

00:03:52.060 --> 00:03:53.880
When we talk,

00:03:53.880 --> 00:03:58.260
if we don't know the grammar that we need, that we have to use,

00:03:58.260 --> 00:04:00.380
for the sentences we are saying

00:04:00.380 --> 00:04:02.880
we are going to end up using a different grammar,

00:04:02.880 --> 00:04:05.800
And these sentences that we are producing

00:04:05.800 --> 00:04:09.680
they become in their turn input for ourselves.

00:04:09.680 --> 00:04:13.820
The problem is that it is bad input. It is input that contains many errors,

00:04:13.820 --> 00:04:15.660
it contains many mistakes.

00:04:15.660 --> 00:04:19.660
And the same thing that happens with grammar happens with the vocabulary.

00:04:19.660 --> 00:04:25.300
Because many times we will need to use words that we still don't know well.

00:04:25.300 --> 00:04:28.800
We are not sure that they can be used in this situation.

00:04:28.800 --> 00:04:31.440
We are not sure whether their meaning

00:04:31.440 --> 00:04:35.780
also really covers the meaning we want to express

00:04:35.780 --> 00:04:41.400
or not, not exactly. Or if it has a similar meaning but not exactly the same.

00:04:41.400 --> 00:04:45.080
Again, we are using vocabulary

00:04:45.080 --> 00:04:47.560
in a way that native speakers would not,

00:04:47.560 --> 00:04:51.120
and we are providing input for ourselves.

00:04:51.120 --> 00:04:54.200
We are building a mental image

00:04:54.200 --> 00:04:56.560
of the language that is not

00:04:56.560 --> 00:05:00.700
really the same one that native speakers have.

00:05:00.700 --> 00:05:04.200
And just as with grammar and vocabulary,

00:05:04.200 --> 00:05:07.660
the same problem happens with pronunciation, pronunciation and accent.

00:05:07.660 --> 00:05:10.820
That is, if we force ourselves to talk

00:05:10.820 --> 00:05:14.020
while we’re not sure of the sounds of the language,

00:05:14.020 --> 00:05:18.260
we are not 100% sure about how things are pronounced,

00:05:18.260 --> 00:05:22.520
we will pronounce them differently. A little differently

00:05:22.520 --> 00:05:27.060
and what we are saying

00:05:27.060 --> 00:05:31.760
in turn it becomes our own input and we learn to speak differently (than native speakers).

00:05:31.760 --> 00:05:37.040
Or if we're talking and we still don't know the sounds of the language well,

00:05:37.040 --> 00:05:40.420
our brain will use the sounds it already knows,

00:05:40.420 --> 00:05:44.320
which are the sounds of our mother tongue, of our own language.

00:05:44.320 --> 00:05:47.180
And connections will be created.

00:05:47.180 --> 00:05:51.700
Our brain will connect the sounds of our mother tongue

00:05:51.700 --> 00:05:54.480
with the language we are learning,

00:05:54.480 --> 00:05:59.340
and that later does not go away, no. We have no way

00:05:59.340 --> 00:06:01.580
to erase these connections.

00:06:01.580 --> 00:06:05.820
And if we keep doing it, we keep speaking, we keep practicing speaking

00:06:05.820 --> 00:06:09.460
before knowing the sounds of the language well

00:06:09.460 --> 00:06:12.520
we will be reinforcing, reinforcing

00:06:12.520 --> 00:06:16.820
that connection, and in the future we will end up with an accent

00:06:16.820 --> 00:06:19.520
more or less strong.

00:06:19.529 --> 00:06:22.060
But an accent or pronunciation

00:06:22.060 --> 00:06:24.740
that really has an effect and that really

00:06:24.740 --> 00:06:30.020
can make it difficult for us to communicate with people who speak the language.

00:06:30.020 --> 00:06:35.800
It really has the effect of making it more difficult for people understand us.

00:06:35.800 --> 00:06:38.480
Sometimes they won't manage to understand us,

00:06:38.480 --> 00:06:43.460
and in general they will have to think much more. They will have to try harder

00:06:43.460 --> 00:06:47.580
to understand us. And I think that that's not a positive thing for anyone.

00:06:47.580 --> 00:06:51.880
However, there are different degrees of pronunciation,

00:06:51.880 --> 00:06:55.980
and I'm not saying that following this method

00:06:55.980 --> 00:07:02.520
you are going to pronounce things exactly the same way as a native speaker.

00:07:02.520 --> 00:07:05.880
I believe we still don't really know of a way

00:07:05.880 --> 00:07:09.320
for everyone to learn a foreign language

00:07:09.320 --> 00:07:13.900
and get to speak perfectly and get to speak exactly

00:07:13.900 --> 00:07:17.520
like a native speaker. But what I am telling you

00:07:17.520 --> 00:07:22.220
is that following this method, according to my experience, you can get

00:07:22.220 --> 00:07:27.960
very close. To get really close to the way native speakers speak their language.

00:07:27.960 --> 00:07:34.940
Maybe you won't be perfect. People may still notice that you are not native speakers, that you are foreigners,

00:07:34.940 --> 00:07:41.040
but you will end up with a very clear pronunciation. With a pronunciation that's very easy to understand.

00:07:41.040 --> 00:07:45.320
Without really making mistakes. Without confusing similar sounds.

00:07:45.320 --> 00:07:48.920
Without confusing words that sound similar.

00:07:48.920 --> 00:07:54.300
And it will be much easier for you to communicate with people who speak the language.

00:07:54.300 --> 00:07:58.820
You won't be mistaken for a native speaker, but they won't have to have a hard time

00:07:58.820 --> 00:08:03.120
listening and trying to understand you. So,

00:08:04.160 --> 00:08:08.900
I don't want to say that it's forbidden to speak the language. That it's forbidden

00:08:08.900 --> 00:08:11.620
to try to speak in the language.

00:08:11.639 --> 00:08:14.540
I want to simply give this information to you

00:08:14.540 --> 00:08:17.880
that if you try to force yourself to speak,

00:08:17.880 --> 00:08:20.280
if you try to make sentences

00:08:20.280 --> 00:08:23.280
that you are not used to yet,

00:08:23.280 --> 00:08:28.100
to use vocabulary that you still don't know well, or simply speak

00:08:28.100 --> 00:08:32.320
when you still haven't got used to the sound of language,

00:08:32.320 --> 00:08:36.680
without listening to the language for at least a few hundred hours,

00:08:36.680 --> 00:08:40.480
you will end up with a knowledge of the language that is different

00:08:40.480 --> 00:08:42.880
to the one native speakers have.

00:08:42.880 --> 00:08:45.900
And that will affect you more or less

00:08:45.900 --> 00:08:48.720
depending on how much you do it.

00:08:48.720 --> 00:08:51.020
If you do it a lot then it will be worse.

00:08:51.020 --> 00:08:55.180
If you do it only sometimes, it will not be so bad.

00:08:55.180 --> 00:09:01.140
Especially, if you begin speaking when your knowledge of the language is already quite good,

00:09:01.140 --> 00:09:04.880
when you are very used to the sounds of the language,

00:09:04.880 --> 00:09:09.200
then it will be much better and it will have much less of an effect.

00:09:09.200 --> 00:09:11.300
And I recommend that you do that.

00:09:11.300 --> 00:09:15.080
But, in the end, it is you who has to choose

00:09:15.080 --> 00:09:19.140
at what point you really want to start speaking.

00:09:19.140 --> 00:09:21.880
It's an advantage if you don't have

00:09:21.880 --> 00:09:25.720
to speak because you don't live in the country where the language is spoken,

00:09:25.720 --> 00:09:30.280
you have it much easier to continue receiving input for longer.

00:09:30.280 --> 00:09:34.920
To leave speaking for later. Because you really don't have a need

00:09:34.920 --> 00:09:36.960
to start talking right now, no.

00:09:36.960 --> 00:09:41.800
Then, when your level in the language is already good enough,

00:09:41.800 --> 00:09:44.400
I recommend speaking. I totally recommend

00:09:44.400 --> 00:09:50.420
making friends in the language, getting a partner, a boyfriend or a girlfriend in the language,

00:09:50.420 --> 00:09:53.740
going to social activities, joining a football club,

00:09:53.740 --> 00:09:56.720
or to bars, or to any other activity

00:09:56.720 --> 00:09:59.910
in which you have to communicate with people in the language.

00:09:59.910 --> 00:10:03.320
I just recommend not doing it too soon.

00:10:03.320 --> 00:10:07.120
And if you really want to do it, if you really want to start

00:10:07.120 --> 00:10:10.700
to communicate, to interact with people,

00:10:10.700 --> 00:10:13.200
I recommend that

00:10:13.200 --> 00:10:18.580
Well, you find a sentence or two that you always say, some questions that you always ask

00:10:18.580 --> 00:10:22.680
and that allow you to have a slightly more passive role.

00:10:22.680 --> 00:10:25.720
Yes, ask about things that interest you

00:10:25.720 --> 00:10:30.060
but let the other person speak most of the time.

00:10:30.060 --> 00:10:33.820
This way you can get more input

00:10:33.820 --> 00:10:36.680
without necessarily having to talk so much.

00:10:36.680 --> 00:10:39.320
Well, that's another idea.

00:10:39.320 --> 00:10:45.400
This is the end of the video on when to start talking.

00:10:45.400 --> 00:10:48.820
And in the next video I'll talk

00:10:48.820 --> 00:10:50.760
about reading.

00:10:50.760 --> 00:10:53.820
When I recommend to start reading

00:10:53.820 --> 00:10:58.140
And also the positive things about reading.

00:10:58.140 --> 00:11:02.800
And also the negative things about starting to read too early on.

00:11:02.800 --> 00:11:07.679
Okay? Alright, see you next time!

title: How to Learn a Language #10: The Future of Language Learning
description: The world has changed since the idea of comprehensible input was first developed. What does modern technology imply for language learning? One thing’s for sure: it will be more fun, more effective, and, we hope, more popular!
subtitles:
WEBVTT
Kind: captions
Language: en

00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:01.460
Hello!

00:00:01.460 --> 00:00:04.620
In this video I want to explain

00:00:04.620 --> 00:00:08.980
what's my ideal future for Dreaming Spanish

00:00:08.980 --> 00:00:11.220
and for language learning.

00:00:11.220 --> 00:00:15.940
What I think is really the ideal way to learn languages,

00:00:15.940 --> 00:00:21.220
and what I hope to be able to build in the future.

00:00:21.220 --> 00:00:25.440
And my idea for Dreaming Spanish, for the future,

00:00:25.440 --> 00:00:31.560
is to build a platform, possibly a website and an app,

00:00:31.560 --> 00:00:35.520
where there is content. There are many videos,

00:00:35.520 --> 00:00:38.880
videos like the ones I make, but for all levels.

00:00:38.880 --> 00:00:41.080
Where you can reach any level

00:00:41.080 --> 00:00:45.600
and where there are many many hours of videos, and very interesting videos.

00:00:45.600 --> 00:00:49.840
Where each person can choose the videos that interest them most,

00:00:49.840 --> 00:00:54.580
that they don't need to watch all the videos, if there are videos that don't interest them.

00:00:54.580 --> 00:00:58.760
Where they can really get hundreds of hours of input

00:00:58.760 --> 00:01:02.060
with videos they find interesting.

00:01:02.060 --> 00:01:05.740
With videos by many teachers. With

00:01:05.740 --> 00:01:10.260
at least 20 different teachers making videos.

00:01:10.260 --> 00:01:13.680
Where you can choose the teachers you like best.

00:01:13.680 --> 00:01:18.000
Where you can listen to different people speaking Spanish

00:01:18.000 --> 00:01:21.840
with different accents, with different ways of speaking.

00:01:21.840 --> 00:01:25.080
Where you can listen to people from different countries.

00:01:25.080 --> 00:01:29.040
And where you have the option to listen to Spanish from Spain,

00:01:29.040 --> 00:01:32.360
but also to Spanish from Mexico, from Colombia...

00:01:32.360 --> 00:01:36.780
I also want this platform to be like your family.

00:01:36.780 --> 00:01:42.300
That when you get there you feel that you are in a new place,

00:01:42.300 --> 00:01:47.560
where they speak a new language, but where you feel welcome.

00:01:47.560 --> 00:01:52.140
That you feel that the people there are like your family,

00:01:52.140 --> 00:01:54.760
Like your new Spanish family.

00:01:54.760 --> 00:02:00.600
And you will be like a baby who has just arrived

00:02:00.600 --> 00:02:04.040
in that country, in that new culture,

00:02:04.040 --> 00:02:07.760
and you will feel that you can grow and you can learn

00:02:07.760 --> 00:02:10.500
safely in that new family.

00:02:10.500 --> 00:02:14.460
Also, this platform would track your level.

00:02:14.460 --> 00:02:17.420
It would be able to measure what level you're at.

00:02:17.420 --> 00:02:23.000
It could show you the progress you've made. I would show you how you've progressed.

00:02:23.000 --> 00:02:27.520
It would recommend which videos to watch at each level,

00:02:27.520 --> 00:02:30.380
which are the best videos,

00:02:30.380 --> 00:02:33.580
the easiest to understand at your level.

00:02:33.580 --> 00:02:37.920
And ideally in the future I would like that in Dreaming Spanish

00:02:37.920 --> 00:02:41.620
there were also, in addition to videos, audios, such as podcasts,

00:02:41.620 --> 00:02:44.660
so no matter where you are you would be able to

00:02:44.660 --> 00:02:48.760
be listening with your phone, be listening to Dreaming Spanish

00:02:48.760 --> 00:02:52.240
and be improving your level of Spanish.

00:02:52.240 --> 00:02:54.580
And if possible, in the future,

00:02:54.580 --> 00:02:57.720
also help you do Crosstalk,

00:02:57.720 --> 00:03:03.020
to find easier ways to find partners to do Crosstalk.

00:03:03.020 --> 00:03:06.740
To guide you a bit about what kinds of conversations to have,

00:03:06.740 --> 00:03:09.380
what types of topics to talk about

00:03:09.380 --> 00:03:12.280
And also opportunities to go abroad.

00:03:12.280 --> 00:03:16.780
If we can put together a platform that makes it easy for people

00:03:16.780 --> 00:03:21.560
to go and spend time abroad, or do a homestay or in some other way

00:03:21.560 --> 00:03:24.020
spend time in contact with the culture,

00:03:24.020 --> 00:03:27.460
it would also make it much easier to learn the language.

00:03:27.460 --> 00:03:31.760
And of course later on to expand it beyond Dreaming Spanish.

00:03:31.760 --> 00:03:35.740
Let's create Dreaming French and Dreaming English and Dreaming Chinese,

00:03:35.740 --> 00:03:39.020
and expand to other languages.

00:03:39.020 --> 00:03:44.000
And of course the ultimate goal of this project, of this platform,

00:03:44.000 --> 00:03:47.820
would be for many people to learn Spanish well,

00:03:47.820 --> 00:03:51.540
for us to help a lot of people

00:03:51.540 --> 00:03:55.160
to reach a very good level of Spanish, a level of Spanish

00:03:55.160 --> 00:03:59.260
higher than they thought they could reach,

00:03:59.260 --> 00:04:04.400
and that by doing this we can show the world

00:04:04.400 --> 00:04:08.220
that you can learn languages, you can learn Spanish,

00:04:08.220 --> 00:04:11.360
in an easier way, in a more fun way,

00:04:11.360 --> 00:04:14.100
and in a more effective and faster way.

00:04:14.100 --> 00:04:18.900
And well, this is my idea about what would be the ideal platform,

00:04:18.900 --> 00:04:23.600
not only for Dreaming Spanish, but what would be the ideal platform for me too

00:04:23.600 --> 00:04:27.260
if I wanted to learn another language, which I do want.

00:04:27.260 --> 00:04:31.600
If I had a platform like this for Thai or Chinese,

00:04:31.600 --> 00:04:34.280
I really would want to use something like this, right?

00:04:34.280 --> 00:04:37.280
Let me know what you think about this idea.

00:04:37.280 --> 00:04:39.400
If you think this is the ideal platform,

00:04:39.400 --> 00:04:44.280
or if you would improve it in some way. If you would add something

00:04:44.280 --> 00:04:48.700
you can tell me. You can send us a message or leave a comment

00:04:48.700 --> 00:04:52.400
to tell me what you think, okay?

00:04:52.400 --> 00:04:55.060
Alright, bye!

title: How to Learn a Language #4: How to Watch Dreaming Spanish Videos

00:00:00.900 --> 00:00:02.480
Hi!

00:00:02.480 --> 00:00:05.480
In this video I'm going to explain

00:00:05.480 --> 00:00:08.740
how to make the most of Dreaming Spanish,

00:00:08.740 --> 00:00:11.640
how to make the most of it, what is the best way

00:00:11.640 --> 00:00:14.340
to watch the Dreaming Spanish videos.

00:00:14.340 --> 00:00:18.520
Because many people ask me, many people ask me in the comments

00:00:18.520 --> 00:00:21.940
what should they do, what videos should they watch,

00:00:21.940 --> 00:00:24.800
how many times should you watch each video,

00:00:24.800 --> 00:00:29.420
and in this video I will explain what is the best way.

00:00:29.420 --> 00:00:32.560
And I hope to answer those questions.

00:00:32.560 --> 00:00:38.160
The first thing I recommend is that you watch very easy videos.

00:00:38.160 --> 00:00:41.660
Videos that are very easy for you, and I would

00:00:41.660 --> 00:00:47.300
even tell you to watch videos that seem too easy for you.

00:00:47.300 --> 00:00:52.780
not just videos that yes, you can follow, you can understand the topic of,

00:00:52.780 --> 00:00:58.660
but rather videos that you really understand very well. Because even in videos that you understand very well

00:00:58.660 --> 00:01:02.000
you will be learning new information

00:01:02.000 --> 00:01:05.720
on how to use grammar and how to use words

00:01:05.720 --> 00:01:09.920
that you may already know, but you will learn new information

00:01:09.920 --> 00:01:13.180
about other ways to use those words.

00:01:13.180 --> 00:01:18.460
But also when you encounter a word

00:01:18.460 --> 00:01:21.740
that is new, that you don't know, or that you don't know well,

00:01:21.740 --> 00:01:24.480
the context will be very clear to you

00:01:24.480 --> 00:01:28.880
because you can understand the previous sentence and the next sentence.

00:01:28.880 --> 00:01:33.320
So you will know exactly what to expect.

00:01:33.320 --> 00:01:38.520
You will have expectations about the meaning of that word,

00:01:38.520 --> 00:01:42.840
and that will help you a lot to be able to learn fast.

00:01:42.840 --> 00:01:48.220
Sometimes we try to force ourselves, we try to do more difficult things

00:01:48.220 --> 00:01:52.600
because we believe that if we try to do something difficult

00:01:52.600 --> 00:01:56.640
and we manage to do it, we're going to learn more, right?

00:01:56.640 --> 00:02:00.800
But using Comprehensible Input, the problem

00:02:00.800 --> 00:02:05.800
is that if we only understand the general topic, the general idea,

00:02:05.800 --> 00:02:10.600
it will be very difficult to understand the meaning of new words.

00:02:10.600 --> 00:02:16.200
It will be very difficult to acquire new vocabulary that we still don't know

00:02:17.540 --> 00:02:21.260
if there are too many words we don't know.

00:02:21.260 --> 00:02:25.480
If in each sentence there are one or two words that we don't know

00:02:25.480 --> 00:02:29.900
we will not understand the sentences well enough

00:02:29.900 --> 00:02:36.220
to be able to deduce the meaning of those new words.

00:02:36.220 --> 00:02:41.660
For example when reading. When we are reading a book to try to improve

00:02:41.660 --> 00:02:44.200
our level of Spanish,

00:02:44.200 --> 00:02:48.500
the research, the studies that have been done on this subject,

00:02:48.500 --> 00:02:54.340
they indicate that the ideal is for us to already know 98%

00:02:54.340 --> 00:02:57.880
of the vocabulary. 98% of the words.

00:02:57.880 --> 00:03:06.180
98% means that there will only be one word in 50 that we don't know.

00:03:06.180 --> 00:03:11.800
In every 50 words we read, there will only be one that we don't know.

00:03:11.800 --> 00:03:16.300
And that is the fastest way to improve in a language.

00:03:16.300 --> 00:03:22.880
If there are more words we don't know, like one in ten, or one in five that we don't know

00:03:22.880 --> 00:03:26.380
then you learn much much more slowly

00:03:26.380 --> 00:03:30.140
and this has been shown by research papers, that

00:03:30.140 --> 00:03:32.920
we will learn much more slowly.

00:03:32.920 --> 00:03:36.700
Many times slower. About four or five times slower.

00:03:36.700 --> 00:03:42.300
It's not only 20%, or 30% slower. It is much slower.

00:03:42.300 --> 00:03:47.640
What's the issue? That there is not much research yet, many papers

00:03:47.640 --> 00:03:50.420
about learning by listening.

00:03:50.420 --> 00:03:56.320
There are many about learning vocabulary by reading, but not many about learning it by listening.

00:03:56.320 --> 00:04:01.819
And when listening, I think it makes sense to expect that

00:04:01.820 --> 00:04:06.540
we can tolerate a little more vocabulary that we don't understand.

00:04:06.540 --> 00:04:11.840
Because when we watch a video, we can see the gestures that the person makes.

00:04:11.840 --> 00:04:14.520
Especially if you watch Dreaming Spanish videos

00:04:14.520 --> 00:04:18.420
you have objects, you have drawings, you have photos,

00:04:18.420 --> 00:04:22.340
and that can help you learn faster

00:04:22.340 --> 00:04:26.721
even if you don't understand that many words, right? That's why I think

00:04:26.721 --> 00:04:33.980
that this doesn't apply, especially, if you start with the superbeginner and beginner levels of Dreaming Spanish.

00:04:33.980 --> 00:04:38.160
I try to provide that extra information so you don't need

00:04:38.160 --> 00:04:41.140
to know all the words.

00:04:41.140 --> 00:04:46.800
But once you improve, you go on improving and you can understand more,

00:04:46.800 --> 00:04:52.800
I recommend, perhaps, that you continue watching videos of a slightly lower level

00:04:52.800 --> 00:04:57.740
than you would prefer, lower than you think is ideal for you.

00:04:57.740 --> 00:05:01.480
because you will learn words faster.

00:05:01.480 --> 00:05:06.940
It is fine from time to time to try to do something a little more difficult.

00:05:06.940 --> 00:05:11.720
Or to watch a harder video, or to watch a movie, or to watch

00:05:11.720 --> 00:05:14.880
something original in Spanish.

00:05:14.880 --> 00:05:20.200
Because it can give you an idea of ​​where you want get to, what the goal is,

00:05:20.200 --> 00:05:25.700
and it can make you feel that now you are understanding a bit more than before.

00:05:25.700 --> 00:05:28.979
So, once in a while it's fine.

00:05:28.980 --> 00:05:33.900
I just recommend to not do only that, to not always do it.

00:05:33.900 --> 00:05:40.040
Don't even do it most of the time. I recommend that most of the time you spend learning

00:05:40.040 --> 00:05:43.180
you spend it with resources that are really easy.

00:05:43.180 --> 00:05:48.860
The second thing I recommend is that you watch entertaining videos.

00:05:48.860 --> 00:05:53.200
Videos you really like. Videos that you really find interesting.

00:05:53.200 --> 00:05:57.520
So, in that sense, I don't know if Dreaming Spanish

00:05:57.520 --> 00:06:01.120
are the best videos. I don't know if they are the most entertaining.

00:06:01.120 --> 00:06:05.240
I try to make them fun, and in the future I hope

00:06:05.240 --> 00:06:09.460
to improve, I hope I get better at making our videos more and more fun,

00:06:09.460 --> 00:06:11.020
more and more entertaining.

00:06:11.020 --> 00:06:17.040
But in any case I recommend that you watch the videos that you like, the ones that interest you the most.

00:06:17.040 --> 00:06:21.480
Especially if you can find videos on topics that you like.

00:06:21.480 --> 00:06:26.900
If you like video games, about video games. If you like history, about history.

00:06:26.900 --> 00:06:29.940
On any subject that really interests you.

00:06:29.940 --> 00:06:35.300
Or if you like humor videos, if you find them funny,

00:06:35.300 --> 00:06:40.280
then watch that kind of videos. The videos that you really feel that you are

00:06:40.280 --> 00:06:44.360
paying attention to. That you don't get distracted easily.

00:06:44.360 --> 00:06:47.480
That you don't start daydreaming.

00:06:47.480 --> 00:06:51.060
So, the third thing I recommend

00:06:51.060 --> 00:06:54.640
is that when you watch a video

00:06:54.640 --> 00:06:58.600
try to understand it. Try to understand the subject,

00:06:58.600 --> 00:07:02.640
try to understand what we are talking about.

00:07:02.640 --> 00:07:05.820
Try to understand in a general way,

00:07:05.820 --> 00:07:10.420
Do not focus on the language we use, do not focus

00:07:10.420 --> 00:07:13.780
on the words, on the vocabulary, on the grammar.

00:07:13.780 --> 00:07:16.380
When you hear a new word

00:07:16.380 --> 00:07:21.680
don't grab it and try to repeat it in your head to memorize it.

00:07:21.680 --> 00:07:25.740
Oh! He said "sardina"! Sardina, sardina, sardina, sardina, ...

00:07:25.740 --> 00:07:27.220
No, that's not ideal.

00:07:27.220 --> 00:07:31.060
To really be able to learn the word "sardina",

00:07:31.060 --> 00:07:36.120
you need to hear it in different contexts, used in different ways

00:07:36.120 --> 00:07:40.800
and connected to different parts of your brain, of your head.

00:07:40.800 --> 00:07:44.620
And just repeating it many times in your head

00:07:44.620 --> 00:07:47.360
won't help you get that.

00:07:47.360 --> 00:07:53.820
And also while you are repeating it you are not listening to the video. You are not listening

00:07:53.820 --> 00:07:58.430
to what I am saying, what the person in the video is saying.

00:07:58.430 --> 00:08:05.160
You are missing opportunities to get more input, and get input that would be useful to you.

00:08:05.160 --> 00:08:10.060
Also if something said in the video seems odd to you,

00:08:10.060 --> 00:08:15.820
or you don't understand why that word is used, why not another one,

00:08:15.820 --> 00:08:19.800
or you don't understand why certain grammar is used and not another one,

00:08:19.800 --> 00:08:23.900
I advise you to not try analyze it, to not analyze it in this way.

00:08:23.900 --> 00:08:28.220
It is much more useful to simply accept it. To accept the reality

00:08:28.220 --> 00:08:32.080
that in this case, this person, for whatever reason,

00:08:32.080 --> 00:08:35.580
this person has decided to use this word,

00:08:35.580 --> 00:08:38.140
or has decided to use this grammar.

00:08:38.920 --> 00:08:43.280
Why do that? Because we don't learn grammar or vocabulary

00:08:43.280 --> 00:08:46.000
we don't learn the usage of words

00:08:46.000 --> 00:08:48.480
just hearing them once.

00:08:48.480 --> 00:08:53.140
This person has used this word, but maybe it's because this person

00:08:53.140 --> 00:08:55.820
always use this word in this situation.

00:08:55.820 --> 00:08:58.460
And the way we are really going to learn

00:08:58.460 --> 00:09:03.340
What words are used. What kind of people use certain words or certain other words,

00:09:03.340 --> 00:09:09.160
is listening to this person talk in different situations, on different topics,

00:09:09.160 --> 00:09:11.800
and also listen to other people

00:09:11.800 --> 00:09:15.280
talk in the same situations, and in other situations.

00:09:15.280 --> 00:09:20.520
And it is with this repetition of listening to the same grammar and the same words

00:09:20.520 --> 00:09:26.340
in different situations, how we really form this mental image

00:09:26.340 --> 00:09:31.200
that allows us to use the vocabulary, to use the grammar, naturally.

00:09:31.200 --> 00:09:33.440
In the right situations.

00:09:33.440 --> 00:09:36.700
If you heard the person in the video

00:09:36.700 --> 00:09:40.560
using a certain word or using certain grammar,

00:09:40.560 --> 00:09:43.720
that's it! You listened to it. That's your job.

00:09:43.720 --> 00:09:45.660
That is your only job.

00:09:45.660 --> 00:09:49.180
That little contribution that has been added to your head,

00:09:49.180 --> 00:09:53.320
that has been added to the knowledge you have of that word,

00:09:53.320 --> 00:09:57.980
that is your job, and it is ideal. Your job when acquiring a language

00:09:57.980 --> 00:10:01.660
is to get that, that little information

00:10:01.660 --> 00:10:05.640
that gets added to that knowledge you have of that word,

00:10:05.640 --> 00:10:11.000
and to constantly do that. To do it again and again and again.

00:10:11.000 --> 00:10:15.100
When you watch a video, don't expect

00:10:15.100 --> 00:10:19.440
by he end of the video to have learned a word perfectly, no.

00:10:19.440 --> 00:10:25.620
You'll get to the end of the video and have learned a small part, 1%,

00:10:25.620 --> 00:10:29.540
1% of 100 words, or 200 words.

00:10:29.540 --> 00:10:31.680
That is your job,

00:10:31.680 --> 00:10:34.840
and this is the way you are going to learn a language faster.

00:10:34.840 --> 00:10:38.080
So in this case it helps, and a lot,

00:10:38.080 --> 00:10:40.120
to not be a perfectionist,

00:10:40.120 --> 00:10:46.740
to not feel a need to understand everything, to understand the reason for everything.

00:10:46.740 --> 00:10:53.640
Because this is also true, in languages ​​there is no why, there is no reason why they are the way they are.

00:10:53.640 --> 00:10:55.680
The language has simply

00:10:55.680 --> 00:10:58.200
evolved over history

00:10:58.200 --> 00:11:03.900
and right now, at this point in time, the language is the way it is and it has simply turned out to be this way.

00:11:03.900 --> 00:11:07.440
So, another way you can see it is:

00:11:07.440 --> 00:11:10.280
Try to be perfectionists.

00:11:10.280 --> 00:11:13.360
Be perfectionists in the sense that

00:11:13.360 --> 00:11:16.340
when you are listening, when you are understanding,

00:11:16.340 --> 00:11:20.600
this little bit of information that you learn every time you understand something,

00:11:20.600 --> 00:11:24.180
is the perfect way to learn the language.

00:11:24.180 --> 00:11:28.940
It is the perfect way to get this knowledge. The same type

00:11:28.940 --> 00:11:32.860
of knowledge that native speakers of the language have.

00:11:32.860 --> 00:11:37.280
It is not a different kind of knowledge. It is not learning rules

00:11:37.280 --> 00:11:42.340
or learn vocabulary through translations, which can lead to many mistakes.

00:11:42.340 --> 00:11:46.240
Which can mislead you in many ways

00:11:46.240 --> 00:11:50.340
and that is imperfect. Trying to understand why, knowing the rules

00:11:50.340 --> 00:11:58.460
will result in something imperfect. In learning a language imperfectly. So,

00:11:58.460 --> 00:12:04.340
if you really are perfectionists and want to learn in the best way, then

00:12:04.340 --> 00:12:07.340
be perfectionists in this way.

00:12:07.340 --> 00:12:12.640
Understanding. Simply listening to things you understand and not trying

00:12:12.640 --> 00:12:17.840
to know why. Why the vocabulary or the grammar are used a certain way.

00:12:17.840 --> 00:12:23.740
So, a question people ask me a lot is: how many times should I watch a video?

00:12:23.740 --> 00:12:27.720
Should I watch a video 2, 3, 20 times?

00:12:27.720 --> 00:12:31.700
Okay, I'm not going to forbid you to watch a video several times.

00:12:31.700 --> 00:12:35.940
I don't necessarily think it's bad to watch a video several times.

00:12:35.940 --> 00:12:38.420
But you should think about this:

00:12:38.420 --> 00:12:41.240
Why do you want to watch a video several times?

00:12:41.240 --> 00:12:46.380
If you want to watch it because you have trouble understanding it, because you believe

00:12:46.380 --> 00:12:50.360
that you will understand it better if you watch it again,

00:12:51.209 --> 00:12:55.000
you can first try watching easier videos.

00:12:55.000 --> 00:12:58.840
I recommend that you first try to watch easier videos.

00:12:58.840 --> 00:13:02.480
And if you can understand easier videos better,

00:13:02.480 --> 00:13:06.420
I recommend that you watch more of those. That you focus

00:13:06.420 --> 00:13:10.620
most of your time on watching those easier videos.

00:13:10.620 --> 00:13:13.000
If you can't find easier videos,

00:13:13.000 --> 00:13:17.040
If you are already watching the easiest videos I have, the superbeginner ones,

00:13:17.040 --> 00:13:20.680
Or if you have finished all the superbeginner videos,

00:13:20.680 --> 00:13:27.820
Then yes. You can watch a video a second or a third time, to see if you understand it better.

00:13:27.820 --> 00:13:32.820
If you haven't watched a video for a while, you can watch it again

00:13:32.820 --> 00:13:40.160
and you may get that feeling of: Oh! Now, since I have learned more Spanish, I have a higher level.

00:13:40.160 --> 00:13:44.420
I understand more. I understand words that I didn't understand before.

00:13:44.420 --> 00:13:47.220
I think that's also a very good thing.

00:13:47.840 --> 00:13:53.880
When I do not recommend you keep watching a video many times is if you get bored.

00:13:53.880 --> 00:13:58.300
If you are watching a video and you already know it by heart, because you have watched it before

00:13:58.300 --> 00:14:02.300
and you realize that you no longer find it very interesting,

00:14:02.300 --> 00:14:07.080
that you are getting bored, that you are not paying attention,

00:14:07.080 --> 00:14:12.840
that are you thinking about something else, then no. Then stop. Stop watching that video.

00:14:12.840 --> 00:14:16.300
And go and watch a video that you find interesting,

00:14:16.300 --> 00:14:20.740
a video that you haven't watched yet, a video with which you can learn something, for example.

00:14:20.740 --> 00:14:25.240
One last thing I recommend is that you watch videos

00:14:25.240 --> 00:14:29.620
where there are different people. Because watching videos

00:14:29.620 --> 00:14:33.160
of always the same person can be fine, and

00:14:33.160 --> 00:14:37.500
at the beginning you start getting used to the way that person speaks,

00:14:37.500 --> 00:14:42.040
to the vocabulary they use, to the pronunciation that person uses.

00:14:42.040 --> 00:14:47.760
Then, once you get used to it, it will be easier for you to understand that person

00:14:47.760 --> 00:14:51.300
and watching videos of that person, or talking to that person

00:14:51.300 --> 00:14:53.600
for a while is fine.

00:14:53.600 --> 00:14:57.860
But it's also very good to have variety and it's very good to change

00:14:57.860 --> 00:15:02.780
and try watch videos of or talking with other people.

00:15:02.780 --> 00:15:06.160
With people who use other vocabulary,

00:15:06.160 --> 00:15:11.740
with people who speak a little differently, or who have a different pronunciation or another accent.

00:15:11.740 --> 00:15:17.180
That's also very good because that way you will learn words that I may not use.

00:15:17.180 --> 00:15:19.780
Because I use just whichever words I use.

00:15:19.780 --> 00:15:24.880
There are many synonyms in Spanish taa. There are many ways to say one thing.

00:15:24.880 --> 00:15:28.740
And other people, even if they are Spanish people,

00:15:28.740 --> 00:15:32.260
will also say the same things differently,

00:15:32.260 --> 00:15:36.340
and listening to different people will help you also

00:15:36.340 --> 00:15:43.340
to understand a wider variety of vocabulary,  expressions ...

00:15:43.340 --> 00:15:47.640
And yes, I know that well, unfortunately, in Dreaming Spanish

00:15:47.640 --> 00:15:50.680
Most videos are by me, I'm alone in them.

00:15:50.680 --> 00:15:54.220
But I hope that from now on I can make more and more videos

00:15:54.220 --> 00:15:57.240
with other people.

00:15:57.240 --> 00:16:03.060
Well, that's it. Finally I just want to tell you to keep watching videos.

00:16:03.060 --> 00:16:06.440
Keep watching more and more videos, as many as you can,

00:16:06.440 --> 00:16:09.620
cause you are going to start noticing very soon

00:16:09.620 --> 00:16:14.320
that you are improving That your level of Spanish is improving.

00:16:14.320 --> 00:16:17.300
In the next video I will explain

00:16:17.300 --> 00:16:22.860
when to start talking. When I recommend that you start practicing speaking.

00:16:22.860 --> 00:16:26.940
Alright. Bye!
